ignore: valid successful matches first; remaining predictions one-to-one against ignored GT with complete-box IoU >= 0.5
bad_corners: spatially localized but failed ordered-corner instances remain both FP and FN
gt_roi: separate diagnostic, excluded from full-system F1
test: requires prior final_selection.json matching checkpoint, inference settings, code and test manifest
video_accuracy: human coverage review is pending until every frame has reviewed evidence; temporal heuristic events are candidates, not GT
